# Welcome to the National Park Saxon Switzerland and the National Park Region

Bizarre rocks and wild gorges. Experience the beauty of Saxony's only national park and discover the wealth of flora and fauna on and between the sandstone cliffs in the national park region. The majestic table mountains and the deeply carved Elbe valley characterise the cross-border Elbe Sandstone Mountains on a large scale. Countless small-scale rock formations, deeply carved narrow gorges, and species-rich forests offer the opportunity to immerse yourself in unspoilt nature. Nature lovers, active holidaymakers, or lovers of quiet relaxation will find impressive nature experiences on the well-marked network of hiking trails with over 100 views. Certified national park guides offer many exciting hiking experiences. The Bohemian Switzerland National Park borders seamlessly on the Czech side.

[View the map of the area](https://nationalpark-saechsische-schweiz.de/en/map) [News (german version)](https://nationalpark-saechsische-schweiz.de/en/news) [Events](https://nationalpark-saechsische-schweiz.de/en/events) [Habitats](https://nationalpark-saechsische-schweiz.de/en/habitats) [Biodiversity](https://nationalpark-saechsische-schweiz.de/en/biodiversity)

## Discover

Saxon Switzerland offers unforgettable nature experiences for locals and visitors alike, from hikes between bizarre rock formations to breathtaking viewpoints.

![](https://nationalpark-saechsische-schweiz.de/uploads/images/Naturbildung/_defaultTransformation/33537/Junior-Ranger-entdecken-den-Wald.webp)

## Understand

Learn more about the nature and history of Saxon Switzerland through educational programmes, or through the work of our department for nature conservation and research.

![](https://nationalpark-saechsische-schweiz.de/uploads/images/Volunteering/_defaultTransformation/315/33-Mitmachen-zuschn.webp)

## Get involved

Engage with activities in the National Park Region! Seize our opportunities and get involved as a volunteer for the National Park and the cultural landscape of Saxon Switzerland.

Hiking, hiking, hiking! This might be the most wonderful thing to do on vacation in the Elbe Sandstone Mountains. The ancient natural landscape with its bizarre rock formations and fascinating flora and fauna is one of Europe's most enchanting hiking areas.

- [Hiking Destinations](https://www.saechsische-schweiz.de/en/hiking)
- [Caspar David Friedrich Trail](https://www.saechsische-schweiz.de/en/holiday/culture/caspar-david-friedrich)

**The multi-day hiking tour through one of the most beautiful landscapes in Europe**

Bastei? Check. Königstein Fortress? Check. Schrammsteine? Check. Pfaffenstein? Check. Anyone who has completed the Malerweg (116 km over 8 stages) can claim to have seen these and countless other highlights of the Saxon Switzerland. This is what makes the trail unique. No other tour through the Elbe Sandstone Mountains offers this abundance of sights!

- [Hiking on the Painter's Way](https://www.saechsische-schweiz.de/en/hiking/malerweg)

> "Be prepared to witness from now on an uninterrupted series of natural beauties and rarities, which will increasingly grow in grandeur, beauty, and magnitude the further you go. The eye will have a pasture for several days, providing the most beautiful nourishment for the mind and heart."

Wilhelm Leberecht Götzinger (1804)

Festivals, theater, exhibitions, museums, manufactories: The variety of excellent art and cultural offerings in Saxon Switzerland is impressive. And the Saxon state and cultural capital Dresden with its world-famous heritage is just an S-Bahn ride away.

- [Art & Culture](https://www.saechsische-schweiz.de/en/holiday/culture)

Sleep in, have a leisurely breakfast, take a swim in the hotel pool, relax in the sauna, then head to a massage or beauty salon: If you prefer spending your vacation days in a bathrobe, Saxon Switzerland is a paradise. The region is one of the top wellness destinations in Germany. Excellent hotels with a wellness factor can be found here, nestled in a unique landscape.

- [Wellness vacation](https://www.saechsische-schweiz.de/en/holiday/wellness)

Discovering, marveling, and relaxing together: Saxon Switzerland is an ideal holiday destination for families. Exciting excursion destinations, child-friendly hikes, nature experiences, and leisure activities provide variety for both young and old. At the same time, comfortable accommodations and short distances invite the whole family to enjoy a stress-free vacation.

- [Family vacation](https://www.saechsische-schweiz.de/en/holiday/family)

Between the Elbe Valley and distinctive table mountains, a versatile cycling region unfolds with relaxed river cycling, scenic tours, and challenging routes in the low mountain range. The Elbe Cycle Route is among the most beautiful cycling paths in Europe, while diverse routes like the RockHead in the hinterland combine intensive natural experiences with athletic challenges. This makes the Saxon Switzerland an outstanding destination for both leisurely and ambitious cycling holidays.

- [Cycling Holiday](https://www.saechsische-schweiz.de/en/holiday/active-offers/cycling)

Warmed rocks, chirping crickets, and the scent of pines in the air. Saxon Switzerland comes highly recommended for a summer vacation in June, July, and August. If table mountains or the cool gorges seem too dull for you - there are plenty of other adventures awaiting.

- [Tips for your summer vacation](https://www.saechsische-schweiz.de/en/saxonswitzerland/seasons/summer)
- [Summer package deals](https://www.saechsische-schweiz.de/en/booking/package-offers)
